descriptions.zh: 星辰不过是我们饥渴的燃料，灾难只是我们野心绽放的土壤。我们将违逆自然法则，锻造一头巨大而不可阻挡到能重塑宇宙的巨兽。
descriptions.en: The stars are but fuel for our hunger, and calamity is merely the soil where our ambition blooms. We shall defy the natural order, forging a beast so immense, so unstoppable, that it will reshape the cosmos.

descriptions.zh:
有一只巨大的虚空孳孽正在星系中横冲直撞。它想要猎杀巨型生物，如果我们替它解决了这些目标，它可能就会放过我们。

目标：寻找并消灭星系中所有四级噬天巨兽。
descriptions.en:
There's a big voidspawn plowing through the galaxy. It wants to kill big behemoths and presumably, if we kill them for it, it might leave us alone.

OBJECTIVE: Find and Kill all tier 4 Behemoths in the galaxy.

descriptions.zh:
随着心智融合的完成，我们的雄心已经近在咫尺了。我们必须适应新的共同身体，并不断转移人民的心智，但更重要的是，我们需要粉碎任何可能的竞争者，无论他们是谁。

§H目标§!：
—寻找并击杀星系中其他所有的4级噬天巨兽。
—完成生长痛局势
—击杀远古虚空孳孽
descriptions.en:
With the Mind Meld complete, only a few more steps lie between us and our ambitions. We must grow accustomed to our new shared body and keep transferring the minds of our people, but more importantly we'll need to crush any would be contender, whomever they may be.

§HOBJECTIVES§!:
- Find and Kill any other class 4 Behemoths in the galaxy.
- Complete the Growing Pains situation.
- Slay the Elder Voidspawn.

descriptions.zh:
[GetInvadersLower]攻击了我们数十年。我们的深空擎天堡 I是第一道防线，但只有解开这些敌人的谜团才能真正带来安全。

每个发现都会带我们向着最终的目标推进，我们终将可以发起反抗，终结我们长久以来的围城。
descriptions.en:
The [GetInvadersLower] have attacked us for decades. Our Deep Space Citadel I stands as the first line of defense, but true safety will only be won by uncovering the truth about our enemies.

With each discovery, we move closer to the day when we can take our fight to them - and our long siege once and for all.

descriptions.zh:
我们又离揭开传送门的奥秘近了一步。尽管还是无法穿越，但我们现在已经拥有了发展必要科技所需的洞见

想要反抗这些敌人，我们需要§Y虫洞稳定§!。
descriptions.en:
We are one step closer to unlocking the portal's mysteries. Though passage is not yet possible, we now have the insight needed to develop the necessary technology.

To bring our fight to the enemy, we require §YWormhole Stabilization§!.

descriptions.zh:
我们发现了敌人的老巢，但是要揭开他们的秘密就要直面他们的防御。

这会是一场恶仗，但在这之后我们最终将能探索§Y[event_target:starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§!恒星系。
descriptions.en:
We have found the cradle of our enemy, but to unlock their secrets it will be necessary to confront their defenses.

The battle will not be easy, but in its aftermath we will at last be free to explore the §Y[event_target:starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§! system.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§!恒星系内的[GetInvadersLower]被清除干净了，但这里的情况却出乎我们的意料。

曾经在我们土地上肆虐的敌人现在只剩下一颗饱受摧残的星球。
descriptions.en:
The [GetInvadersLower] have been purged from the §Y[starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§! system, but the situation here is very different from what we expected.

All that remains of our tormentors is an apparently decimated world.
